title: Critique
description: The adversarial review of an intent's plan under .ai/repo/project/critiques/<intent>.yaml: structured findings, each resolved open, planned into an issue that serves the intent, or rejected with a reason. Work serving the intent may not start while the intent has no critique or a blocking finding is open.

intent.description: The intent whose plan was reviewed; also the file name.

reviewed_at.description: The commit the plan was reviewed at.

reviewed_revision.description: The revision of the intent's plan this review was stamped against: written by `majordomus-cli intent oppose <intent> --record`, never by hand (ADR 0112). Absent in a critique nobody stamped. Work is refused while it differs from the plan's current revision.

reviewed_with.description: The tool that stamped the review, with its version. Written with reviewed_revision.

subject.description: <intent>#<criterion>, an issue id or a milestone id.

resolved_by.description: Who resolved the finding. Required of every resolution that is not open where the policy says intent.opposition: required.

source.description: Who or what found it: a session, a person, an advisor. Optional; a finding without one is read as the reviewer's (reviewed_by).
